verification_report.summary: The proof is correct under the three accepted elementary analytic inputs. The competitor envelopes are well-defined and genuine whenever nonempty; all convex inequalities extend across pole and upper-regularization exceptional sets via canonical quasi-psh comparison. The elementary closure properties, both stretch-closure assertions, the direct finite-rooftop construction, and P_theta[u]=P_theta[varphi] follow without closedness, semipositivity, bigness, model-reference, or mass hypotheses. The b=1 and N=1 cases, common poles, common translations, and the L1/upper-regularization passages were checked explicitly. ALS26 and XL26 are accurate contextual attributions only and are not used as mathematical inputs. No Popovici result is used.
